VERIFIED CARBON STANDARD PROJECT DESCRIPTION (PDD)
Project Name: Acre Native Forest Conservation and REDD+ Project
Project ID: VCS-1396
Standard Registry: Verified Carbon Standard (Verra)
Project Proponent: Amazonian BioCarbon Ventures Ltd.
Country: Brazil
Region: State of Acre, Amazon Basin
Document Version: 1.2
Submission Date: 2024-02-15

APPLIED METHODOLOGY AND SECTORAL SCOPE
Methodology: VM0007 REDD+ Methodology Framework (Version 1.6)
Sectoral Scope: 14 (Agriculture, Forestry, and Other Land Use - AFOLU)
Applicability Conditions:
The project activity meets all applicability conditions under VM0007
for avoided unplanned deforestation in tropical dense rainforests.

PROJECT BOUNDARY AND ACCOUNTING AREA
Geographic Location: Southwestern Amazon, Acre, Brazil.
Total Project Accounting Area: The project boundary encompasses a
verified total area of 18,500 hectares of primary tropical moist forest.
Geographic Coordinates: Upper left: -70.50, -9.20; Lower right: -70.40, -9.30.
The spatial boundary is defined in boundary.geojson.

VERIFICATION AND MONITORING REPORTING PERIOD
Verification Reporting Period:
Monitoring Period Start Date: 2021-01-01
Monitoring Period End Date: 2023-12-31
Total Duration: 36 calendar months.
All baseline deforestation models and carbon stock measurements have been
completed for this specific reporting interval.

CREDIT ISSUANCE AND CANOPY MONITORING RESULTS
Net Emission Reductions:
Total Credits Issued: 340,000 VCUs (Verified Carbon Units)
requested for issuance for the 2021-2023 reporting period.
Remote Sensing Canopy Monitoring:
Canopy Cover Change: The project monitoring team observed a
claimed canopy change of +3.2% across the project accounting area
relative to baseline degradation.
